semantic.justification: Consumed ICU cstring.h uprv_strtol base-ten binding on the pinned long64 platform. End pointer, C whitespace/sign, no-conversion position and saturation are retained; other bases and errno/ABI are outside this binding. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced.
